reviewTriggers: A new official election or vacancy notice, representative change, nomination or result. Do not infer an event from a countdown or absence.
A boundary change, new ABS release, revised council budget, project-stage decision or changed service information.
A source correction, a community observation with permission to share, or changed scope or maturity in a connected project.
A requested extension beyond this Redland City example. Recheck geography, institutions, source rights and ordinary local language rather than copying facts into another place.
note: The 24 Redlands Twinkles are draft local seeds: one ordinary gripe, a self-contained one-breath line and a path into the serious room. They are illustrative wording, not resident quotations, verified complaints, a survey, public-support estimates or endorsed Civic Ledger entries. The earlier human questions and explanations are retained as question and context. Connected P4A systems are proposals and workbenches, not installed council services. Source checks establish what a linked source contains; they do not verify every claim made by an external project. Unknown costs, contribution and effects remain unknown. No candidate or election is announced here.

trinity.cost: What it cost: money, paid work, materials, infrastructure and continuing obligations, including who carries the burden.
trinity.free: What was given freely: chosen time, care, knowledge and resources. A verified human hour is counted once, with no fixed dollar conversion.
trinity.change: What changed: intended and observed benefit, harm, access, skills, ecology, relationships and time. An aspiration is separate from a measured result.

rules: One ordinary scene; use the quiet version for care, grief or harm when a gag would be inappropriate.
Name one actual everyday gripe in the title. The self-contained one-liner stays on that same gripe.
Say the gripe in one breath. Put the evidence, policy options and participation in the connected serious room.
Punch at systems, forms, deals and doors, never at people, service, culture or grief.
Check factual claims against original evidence before endorsement; draft wording is not a verified complaint.
Keep the pattern open for people to adapt to their own place and verified experience.
